title: PYTHON Packages NOW Vulnerable to Node2Shell
content_md:
Turns out that Node2Shell affects more than just Node! Python packages Brotli and brotlicffi are also affected by this vulnerability, but don't have a CVE yet.. submitted by /u/One_Paint8721 [link] [comments]
